page.overview:
Who is Agarushnawokliag?

Agarushnawokliag was once a foe of Voz, who served as his warden when he was imprisoned on Oa in the past. At some point, Agarushnawokliag broke out and later encounter Hal Jordan who ultimately defeated him and brought him back to Mogo. On Mogo, Agarushnawokliag broke free from his construct prison but was once again subdued by the Lanterns, due to fear from Hal Jordan's family.
